title: Fuse — a premium Shopify theme by UTD
description:
Fuse — a premium Shopify theme by UTD, in the official Shopify Theme Store.

Fashion, sport, wellness, accessories: Fuse takes your own content and your own settings. Hero, image banners and a brand logo row, category cards, a selection block with filters, shop the look with hotspots on your own photo, collections, editorial tiles, a blog and a newsletter, a mega menu that can show products, image zoom, promo popups, gift wrapping, product options and product tabs — all of it in the theme editor, no code.

Fifty-eight features on the Fuse page, against a median of 47.5 across the eight paid themes we counted on 30.09.2026 on their own public store pages.
One-time payment, lifetime licence. No subscription, no expiration.
Try it free in your own store — pay only when you publish.

Fuse in the Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/fuse
All UTD themes: https://themes.shopify.com/themes?q=utd

AI disclosure: the voice-over and the background music are AI-generated. Every screen in this video is a real screen recording of our own live Fuse demo store.

Developed by UTD — https://utdweb.team
